svg.title: White Relief over White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Thin neutral curve is a diagrammatic relief-edge guide, not grey paint. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.moma.org/collection/works/88885; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
